newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $117/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $117/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1400 lbs 116.00- 117.00. ( weighted average 116.55 )
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 116.00- 117.00. ( weighetd average 116.41)

Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was moderate, both classes steady to $0.50 higher, USDA said. Demand and seller interest fair. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Few loads Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1375 lbs 72.00- 73.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 72.00-73.00, few 73.50.) Confirmed: 6,500 Last Week: 28,400 Last Year: 5,900 Wk To Date: 6,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 34,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr: 7,900
